title: Keep the analytics privacy line next to the analytics on the reader pages, never in Base.astro, and keep it true
body: The footer line (footerPrivacy* keys in content/schema/messages.ts) says what is measured: Clarity records anonymous sessions WITHOUT cookies (consent declared denied, memory analytics/consent) and Cloudflare Web Analytics uses no cookies either, linking Microsoft's privacy statement. It renders where the analytics run: the landing's foot (src/components/v2/Landing.astro) and the brief view (src/components/HomeDocument.astro). Never in src/layouts/Base.astro: if analytics are removed the line goes with them instead of being orphaned on /cv. If Clarity's consent ever changes to granted, this line must change in the same diff (it would then be false) and a consent mechanism is needed for EU visitors. Starting Clarity on first interaction (src/scripts/analytics.ts) is a cost decision, not consent, and must not be described as one.
not_derivable: That the line's wording is tied to the consent choice, and why it sits with the analytics rather than in the layout, is not recorded in code.
